'''Sean Torrens''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 85 from Myrtle Beach, SC, whose slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He became a Squadron Member in October 1998, promoting the game in Myrtle Beach.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

He also promoted [[Young Jedi]].<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
My name is Sean Torrens, from Myrtle Beach, South Carolina.  I was born at a very young age and remember seeing Star Wars in it's second release run in the theaters (in 1977-78).  From that point on I was hooked.

I had always liked gaming and strategy, so when I found out they were making a CCG based on Star Wars, I harassed my local comic book/card store every day for two months before the release date and was the first person to buy some when it arrived in December of 1995.

I became a sanctioned tournament director as soon as I heard it was available and play in tournaments out of town myself.

I became a Squadron Member back in October of 1998 and have had such a fun time since then.  I play and promote Classic Star Wars as well as Young Jedi and I even have a local youth (Kenneth Chan) who is my "Jedi Padawan."

If you are ever in the Myrtle Beach area for vacation, look me up!  I am always looking for a challenger!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
